title: As Expected? Efficient LLM Planning via Expectation-Observation Consistency Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.02438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM planning often relies on reactive executors (e.g., ReAct) that generate a single action at each step to remain grounded in the latest observations, incurring substantial inference cost. Batched executors reduce this cost by predicting multiple actions in a single model invocation, yet they are prone to compounding errors, as intermediate observations are ignored. We propose an expectation-observation consistency verification (EOCV) mechanism for batched executors, preserving grounding while improving efficiency. The mechanism generates expectations of action outcomes and compares them with the resulting observations. Consistency permits continued execution, whereas mismatches trigger early termination and replanning from the current observation. translated_title: 如预期吗？通过期望-观察一致性验证实现高效的大语言模型规划
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）规划通常依赖反应式执行器（如ReAct），它在每一步生成单个动作以保持与最新观察结果的一致性，但这会带来高昂的推理成本。批处理执行器通过在单次模型调用中预测多个动作来降低这一成本，然而由于忽略了中间观察结果，容易产生误差累积。我们提出了一种面向批处理执行器的期望-观察一致性验证（EOCV）机制，在提高效率的同时保持与环境的贴合。该机制生成对动作结果的预期，并将其与实际观察结果进行比较：若一致，则继续执行；若不一致，则提前终止并基于当前观察结果重新规划。在基于文本和多模态的基准测试上、跨多个骨干模型的实验表明，EOCV与反应式执行器的平均任务性能大致相当，同时将推理成本降低了29-35%。
tldr: 本文提出期望-观察一致性验证（EOCV）机制，通过将批处理执行器对动作结果的预期与实际观察结果比对，一致则继续执行、不一致则提前终止并重新规划，在保持任务性能的同时将推理成本降低29-35%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Expectation-Observation Consistency Verification (EOCV) mechanism for batched LLM executors, which compares predicted action outcomes with actual observations to either continue execution or trigger early replanning, achieving comparable task performance while reducing inference cost by 29-35%.
